decision.explanation: The question asks 'When was Beacon Mill last worked?' Two distinct sources provide conflicting years for this event. D1S6 states that the mill was last worked for trade in 1921, while D5S5 claims it was last worked for trade in 1955. Both statements refer to the same mill and the same relation ('last worked for trade'), so they represent competing assertions about the same referent. Since neither source is explicitly invalidated by another, both answers remain valid under the principle of preserving distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers.
